# Build & Learn — One Verified Tutorial, Multiple Platform Assets

**Purpose:** Turn one *reproducible source lesson* into a discovery post and appropriate later platform versions. This is editorial packaging, not an automated cross-posting feature. The **canonical truth** is the versioned [tutorial runbook](../templates/TUTORIAL-RUNBOOK.md); every platform adapts the explanation without changing untested steps.

## V1.3 cross-platform relevance gate

A cross-platform tutorial adaptation is allowed only if the content is first [eligible under the AI work-efficiency or lawful monetization gate](TUTORIAL-VALUE-AND-MONETIZATION-GATE.md). A “3 months to profit” anecdote or broad platform growth playbook alone is not an AI efficiency tutorial. Reframe with actual job-to-be-done, original automation mechanism, human review, baseline, attributable evidence and cost/permissions. For X revenue or platform onboarding guides, prioritize current official policy over viral X Articles; old X Revenue Sharing closed September 2026. Keep the [mandatory post + 16:9 checked PNG/JPG + ALT](POST-IMAGE-DELIVERY-GATE.md) pairing intact.

## Platform comparison (verified guidance vs editorial suggestions)

| Distribution surface | What the platform recommends / supports | Proposed asset (our editorial choice) |
|---|---|---|
| **X first (now)** | Official [X Articles guide](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/articles) stresses a clear purpose, title, evidence, skimmable sections, images and concise linked teasers; [X Threads](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/create-a-thread) supports connected posts. Paid eligibility can restrict Articles. | **1 original English Post + relevant actual 16:9 PNG/JPG + ALT + GitHub runbook link**; max 3 if truly requires Thread. Do not publish "Full guide" unless actual link exists. |
| **Xiaohongshu (later)** | [Official education](https://school.xiaohongshu.com/) organizes creation from positioning to notes and audience; official [note guidance](https://school.xiaohongshu.com/lesson/normal/af0fe7e97bb0433fac9da5d1df52b07f) discusses clear covers/titles, search questions, practical use and platform-specific data. Some examples are merchant-specific. | Chinese **step carousel**: cover shows exact result → audience/prerequisites → numbered actions with real captures → checkpoint → failures → source/cost. Use native appropriate ratio after preview; don't assert a universal algorithm or guaranteed traffic. |
| **YouTube (later)** | [Creator tips](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/13616340?hl=en) group content by format/audience/topic; [chapters](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9884579?hl=en) help revisit sections; [retention](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9314415?hl=en) shows difficult/skipped sections. | Real **screen-capture** teaching: demonstrate end result up front → prerequisites/cost → narrated sequential clicks/commands → run verification → common errors → review notes → timestamped chapters and linked GitHub source. |
| **Bilibili (later)** | [Bilibili's official creator-course catalog](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1M3411A77j/) includes positioning, topic selection, titles/covers and operational analysis. The reference is a creator course, not proof any structure guarantees plays. | More complete Chinese series/course with chapters, screen/terminal demonstration, exact environment notes and resources in description; avoid unauthorized reuploads. |
| **Douyin (later)** | [Official Douyin enterprise creator course](https://school.douyin.com/premium/course/6901561449299050509) teaches positioning, content and retention. | Short, outcome-first demonstration of **one reproducible step**, with full tutorial linked where the interface/rules permit. Don't squeeze an entire complicated installation into a misleading short clip. |
| **GitHub / Docs (canonical)** | [GitHub Actions lessons](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/tutorials) are task-led; [GitHub Skills](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey/git-and-github-learning-resources) provides interactive automated checks. | Plain Markdown, exact versions, commands, expected outputs, failure branches, safe sample files and one acceptance test. Future searchable site only after enough tested lessons exist. |

## Suggested single-week production sprint (flexible, not a guaranteed duration)

- **Session A — Demand**: find ONE learning task; record actual question URL/learner background; reject overly broad “learn LLM in 5 minutes.”
- **Session B — Provenance**: official documents + one or two high-quality curricula + Github code/Release and limits, versions and license check.
- **Session C — Reproduce**: execute minimal path in clean/test environment; capture safe screenshots, terminal output, checkpoints; record encountered failure and recovery; don't fake execution.
- **Session D — Teach**: runbook for novice with every required step; friend/second environment test if available; fix gaps.
- **Session E — Art-direct**: create one real, topic-specific **X 16:9 PNG/JPG** from evidence/schematic, meaningful English ALT. For Chinese gallery reuse your original factual captures with new Chinese typesetting, not arbitrary AI art.
- **Session F — Release**: commit full tutorial first; then English X copy/image; then optional other platform derivatives (no unauthorized cross-post API).
- **Session G — Learn**: issue log, learner blocker, version drift, X bookmarks/quality replies; fix broken steps, keep changelog and mark outdated tutorials.

This is **one tutorial package over multiple sessions**, not seven separate posts. Weekly editorial load must stay compatible with daily X activity.

## Example transformation — GitHub LLM learning (NOT yet reproduced)

**Learning outcome:** select one supported Datawhale DIY-LLM exercise and prove a successful result in the chosen environment.

- Primary curriculum: https://github.com/datawhalechina/diy-llm (checked README prerequisites: Python/PyTorch/math; optional GPU topics).
- **GitHub full guide candidate:** learner prerequisites → pick exact chapter → pin commit and environment → copied setup commands from verified lesson → run selected exercise → expected output+check → one documented issue/fix → cost/safety → lessons learned.
- **X hook direction:** "Most 'learn LLM on GitHub' lists fail at environment setup. A useful learning roadmap must name versions, one runnable lesson and its success check." This is a sample thought **not an already approved/published X post**.
- **X image direction:** authentic chapter layout / test screenshot + exact outcome caption, or controlled 3-step editorial flow; only after step actually executed.
- **Xiaohongshu variant:** clear Chinese cover "用 GitHub 学 LLM：从环境到第一项可验证结果", numbered screenshot gallery plus environment and troubleshooting.
- **YouTube variant:** screen recording of actual environment/install/first exercise with timestamps; no fabricated demo footage.

## Accessibility and content provenance

- Include ALT for every X image; captions or transcript for video derivatives.
- Remove names, IPs, OAuth tokens, repo private contents and logs before publishing screenshots.
- Source link to original creators; paraphrase, add own reproduction/teaching value, do not duplicate whole course or image without license.
- Re-test tutorials after major upstream changes; mark `needs_revalidation` instead of letting stale commands remain stamped PASS.
